d:
The Pistons defeated the Nets, 110-94 tonight in Brooklyn. Cade Cunningham contributed a team-high 20 points to go with 5 rebounds and 4 assists, with Ronald Holland II of the Pistons adding an additional 18 points (6-10 FG, 2-5 3P) and 4 steals in the game. Moritz Wagner finished with a team-high 16 points along with 8 rebounds for the Nets in the losing effort. The Pistons improve their record to 5-1 with the win, while the Nets fall to 0-5 for the season.
